olivia: quick Q — our async microbatcher (prefetcher) is returning 200s but i can't find spans for those requests in jaeger. logs have req_id but no trace id. where should I start?
ben: start with the worker's OTEL envs. common culprit is exporter disabled or sampler set to 0. check OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER and OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY on the pod.
maria: also verify the service injects traceparent into the job payload. if the producer doesn't pass trace context, the worker will start a new root (or none if sdk misconfigured). search for traceparent in the logs: `grep -R "traceparent" /var/log/prefetcher`
sam: quick checklist: 1) is otelcol running on the host? `kubectl get pods -n observability` 2) consumer/app has SDK init code? 3) sampling mismatch between languages (node default probabilistic vs java always-on).
olivia: infra shows otelcol up. i checked pod envs — OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp and OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY=0.01 (yikes). we batch a lot of traffic so this could explain missing spans. thoughts on a safe canary?
ben: set sampler prob to 0.25 for canary subset of workers and collect for ~10 min. easier: override via a deployment annotation for a single replica. remember to bump logs so we can map req_id->trace_id for a sample.
maria: dashboard links: prefetcher traces: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/prefetcher-traces?orgId=1 ; req->trace lookup: https://logs.redwood.local/kibana/app/discover#/?q=req_id:%22{req_id}%22 . use a sample req_id and open both.
sam: for a manual smoke test you can force a trace header through curl to the API and then watch the worker: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/prefetch -H "traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" -d '{"key":"test"}'
```
olivia: handy — i will flip canary sampler to 0.25 and post a couple req_ids. @infra-oncall-bot if we see spike in spans or CPU regressions please ping.
infra-oncall-bot: noted — creating incident watch for prefetcher canary (ttl 15m). will alert on >2x CPU or >5% error rate. :eyes:
ben: if spans still missing after sampler change, check instrumentation: are we using manual context propagation in the Kafka consumer? the node client needs `propagation: new W3CTraceContext()` in init.
maria: one more quick tip — if you see partial traces (only root or only downstream), check 1) kafka producer instrumentation 2) any gateway that strips traceparent (apigw config).
olivia: thanks all — i'll update thread with req_ids in ~15m and then we can decide rollback or scale. :thumbsup:
